Create one original Summonlab candidate summon portrait as a cinematic semi-realistic painted drawing. Use visible brush planes and controlled illustrative detail: not a photograph, not photoreal skin, not plastic 3D, and not cel anime. Portrait canvas 1024 x 1536. Exactly one weaponless adult, full body, three-quarter standing pose, with the entire head, both hands, both feet, hair, clothing, and all accessories fully inside a generous safe margin. Warm pale parchment studio wash, restrained warm color response, soft grounding shadow, no environmental story.

New identity Aden Quoreth: 30-year-old woman, 163 cm (short), plus-size heavy construction with substantial natural mass, skin value band-6-deepest. Face: round full face; deep-set eyes and a heavy level brow; long straight nose, narrow upper lip; one brow notch. Calm closed-mouth neutral expression with no smile, grin, or theatrical acting.

Hair: brown-chestnut, shaved-close-cropped, deliberate accent: shaved temple geometry. Wardrobe: layered-wrap, specifically overlapping wrap panels, an off-center waist tie, divided trousers, and soft boots; a divided hem and broad folded collar; bounded palette marigold-green. Visible personal details: a compact finger-line tattoo family; a repaired cuff with bright thread. Make a tattoo, scar, freckle field, or birthmark the primary recognition device. Maintenance cue: visible mending treated as prideful craft. Color treatment: keeps color restrained to layered edges. Pose cue: torso angles three-quarter while both arms hang in deliberate asymmetric ease. Include a tiny cloth-wrapped notebook only as a quiet personal object, never as a weapon.

This is ordinary but intentionally designed 1-star mortal clothing. No weapon, armor, crown, magic, aura, or glow. No affinity cue, elemental gem, floating, frame, printed star, number, UI, logo, watermark, text, extra person, duplicated anatomy, cropped extremity, or published-character resemblance. Fantasy hair colors are matte dye or pigment, never supernatural emission. Preserve plausible anatomy while allowing the declared body construction to be extreme.
